package.name: mower_sessions_recorder
package.description: Records mowing sessions for OpenMower. Subscribes to mower_logic's high-level state and the absolute pose; on every MOWING enter/exit transition, accumulates duration and travelled distance and persists the session to disk. Publishes the full list as JSON on xbot_monitoring/mowing_sessions so xbot_monitoring rebroadcasts it to MQTT (mowing_sessions/json) for the openmower-app /statistics page.
